instruction: I need to finalize the presentation in LibreOffice Impress. Please set the presentation to start from slide 3 ("Discuss:") instead of slide 1 when running the slideshow.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the slideshow starting slide. The evaluator checks if the presentation properties specify slide 3 as the starting slide. This is stored in presentation.xml settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic has critical flaws in extracting the starting slide setting from presentation.xml
The getter attempts to read a 'show' attribute and parse it as integer, which is not the correct PPTX format for starting slide settings
Generic element search for tags containing 'slide' or 'start' is unreliable and not aligned with actual PPTX/LibreOffice structure
Missing the correct XML attribute/element path: starting slide in PPTX is typically stored in showPr element but with different structure than what the getter expects
Default return value of 0 means if the setting isn't found (likely case), evaluator will incorrectly report slide 1 as starting slide
The evaluator will likely fail to detect whether the user correctly set slide 3 as the starting slide
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Research the correct XML structure for starting slide in PPTX format (typically in ppt/presentation.xml under showPr element)
Update getter to look for the correct XML attribute/path that stores the starting slide index in LibreOffice Impress PPTX files
Consider using python-pptx library or similar to reliably extract presentation properties instead of manual XML parsing
Add proper error handling for cases where the starting slide setting may not be explicitly set in the file
Test the getter with an actual PPTX file where starting slide has been manually set to verify the extraction logic works
